summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting that its board approved a one-month extension of the deadline to complete an initial business combination from June 3, 2026, to July 3, 2026. This is the second of ten potential monthly extensions available under its charter, extending up to March 3, 2027. In connection, the company deposited $13,897.14 into its trust account. No shareholder meeting, redemption offer, or change in deal terms was announced. The filing is a routine administrative update for a SPAC extending its combination window. No special situation event is disclosed.
